hooks.text: You don't need five days a week. You need two you'll actually keep.
hooks.rationale: Contradicts the split-first belief this audience already holds, and does it in one breath without hedging.

hooks.text: The program isn't the problem. The version of you who had six free hours is.
hooks.rationale: Names the frustration the viewer is currently living in — the abandoned plan — without blaming them for it.

hooks.text: Here's the boring part nobody tells you about training twice a week.
hooks.rationale: Opens a gap and uses one of the creator's own signature openers, so the hook already sounds like her.
